deadline.value: Submit everything by December 15, 2026 for full consideration; Vivien Thomas Scholars applicants must apply by December 1.
deadline.quote: Please submit all application materials (including letters of recommendation) by December 15, 2026 to receive full consideration.

gre_general.value: GRE General is encouraged but not required.
gre_general.quote: We encourage (but do not require) applicants to report scores for the GRE general and GRE chemistry subject tests.

gre_subject.value: Chemistry GRE is encouraged but not required.
gre_subject.quote: We encourage (but do not require) applicants to report scores for the GRE general and GRE chemistry subject tests.

entry_route.value: Apply with a bachelor's degree in chemistry or a related science; no master's is needed.
entry_route.quote: Undergraduate majors in chemistry, biology, earth sciences, mathematics, or physics may apply as well as all well-qualified individuals who will have received a BA degree before matriculation.

funding.value: The page says about 80 fellowships, research appointments and teaching assistantships exist but does not say all admitted students are funded.

supervisor.value: The page does not mention contacting a supervisor before applying.

notes: Application fee and English rules follow the Krieger record.
